question: In which year did Rudrankksh Patil win gold in the men's 10 m air rifle event in the ISSF World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **At the ISSF World Cup 2023 in Cairo,** India’s **Rudrankksh Balasaheb Patil **emerged victorious in the men’s 10m air rifle event.
 
• He secured the gold medal by defeating Germany’s Maximilian Ullbrich with a score of 16-8 in the thrilling final match.
